howto.what: 装上后，Claude会照步骤把WhatsApp Business Cloud API接入项目：复制适配器到src/channels、注册到频道索引、安装固定版本依赖，跑构建和测试验证，并引导你配置Meta凭证与Webhook。
howto.when: 当你说要添加WhatsApp频道、处于/setup流程需要接入WhatsApp，或要求升级已有WhatsApp Cloud适配器时触发。

say.text: 帮我接入WhatsApp Business Cloud API
say.note: Claude会开始复制适配器并安装。

say.text: 把WhatsApp Cloud频道添加到我的项目
say.note: 会注册并运行构建测试。
会重新应用步骤，并提示更新Webhook路径。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can connect your project to the WhatsApp Business Cloud API by copying the adapter, registering it, installing the pinned dependency, and running build/tests. It also guides you through Meta credentials and webhook setup.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a WhatsApp channel, when the /setup flow needs WhatsApp integration, or when upgrading an existing WhatsApp Cloud adapter.

say_en.text: Connect my project to WhatsApp Business Cloud API
say_en.note: Claude starts copying the adapter and installing dependencies.

say_en.text: Add the WhatsApp Cloud channel to my project

say_en.note: Re-runs apply steps and reminds you to update webhook path.
